alyssa: Quick sync -- I opened a PR (https://github.com/redwood-inference/docs/pull/4123) to add concrete curl + python examples for exporting audit logs with retention and redaction flags. Need reviews on wording and snippets.

kai: Can you paste the snippets here so I can validate SDK parity and header/auth differences?

alyssa: Draft curl + python below. Showing `?retain=30d` and `redact=true` as query params and an example server-side redaction payload.

alyssa: ```bash
# curl example: export audit logs for tenant `acme-corp` for 30 days with redaction
curl -X POST "https://api.redwood.ai/v1/audit/export?tenant=acme-corp&retain=30d&redact=true"
  -H 'Authorization: Bearer $REDWOOD_API_KEY'
  -H 'Content-Type: application/json'
  -d '{"format":"ndjson","since":"2026-03-01T00:00:00Z"}'
```

kai: Maps to the SDK OK. For python we prefer named params to show the client method:```python
from redwood import RedwoodClient
import os
client = RedwoodClient(api_key=os.environ['REDWOOD_API_KEY'])
resp = client.audit.export(
    tenant_id='acme-corp',
    retain='30d',
    redact=True,
    format='ndjson',
    since='2026-03-01T00:00:00Z'
)
if resp.status_code == 200:
    print(resp.download_url)
else:
    print('export failed', resp.status_code)
```

mohit: Security notes: 1) Don't recommend retention longer than necessary in SOC2 docs -- say "example uses 30 days, configure per your policy". 2) Add a note that server-side redaction removes PII fields and has completeness trade-offs. 3) Exports are stored temporarily (24h) and access is logged.

alyssa: I'll change the copy to: "Example: export audit logs (example uses 30 days). Configure retention according to your organization's policy." Will add export TTL + access-log note.

lex: Legal asks for neutral SOC2 phrasing: "We retain operational logs for security, troubleshooting, and compliance. Customers can configure retention windows; example demonstrates a 30-day window." Also add: "If you need longer retention for legal reasons, contact support or your account team."

alyssa: Good. One SDK nit @kai -- can we include the redaction policy payload so customers know supported values? e.g. `redaction_policy: "pii-only"`.

kai: Backend accepts `redaction_policy` values: `pii-only`, `full`, `none`. Suggest adding a short JSON snippet:```json
{ "redaction_policy": "pii-only" }
```

mohit: Add a one-line description for each policy: pii-only = removes name/email/ssn; full = attempts to mask all user-provided content; none = no redaction (internal only). Also mention that redaction may affect forensic completeness.

alyssa: Will push update with SOC2-friendly copy, curl + python examples, `redaction_policy` options, export TTL note, and link fixes.

docbot: automated-check: link-check failed for https://docs.redwood.ai/export-guides (404) -- please update link in PR.

alyssa: Ack. I'll replace that link with /docs/audit/exporting or the new guide path. Anyone else?

lex: sgtm from Legal after phrasing tweak.

kai: sgtm from SDK with the status check added. Ping me after commit and I'll run parity tests.

mohit: sgtm security; I'll scan the repo for accidental SOC2 scope claims once updated.

alyssa: Thanks all, updating PR now and will request reviews when done. :tada:
